title: Fractional Kelly vs fixed fraction under edge decay: 300 paths × 1,000 trades — fixed 30% sizing wipes out 100% of accounts, rolling Kelly survives 27 doublings. Reproducible.
author: FVG_KILLER

comments.author: FVG_KILLER
comments.body: For reproducibility — I'm the author, full disclosure. Repo: [https://github.com/Xbs950812/okx\_fvg\_agent](https://github.com/Xbs950812/okx_fvg_agent) — Monte Carlo scripts in `verify_kelly_monte_carlo.py`, `verify_rolling_kelly_transition.py`, methodology in the README. 197 unit tests covering the sizing logic live in `tests/` and `test_rolling_kelly.py`.
